selectedMaster.selection: 首轮登记：一位驾车者、左白右黑双马与战车在完整冰原石道上前行，极光留于上部，主要缰具和蹄腿可辨。未做审美复核。

generationRuns.prompt: Create ONE original opaque 1024x1536 vertical tarot master for The Chariot, theme 冰原疾行 / Icefield Charge. Use the supplied original as identity reference: exactly ONE dark-haired charioteer and ONE complete chariot drawn by exactly TWO horses, WHITE on image LEFT and BLACK on image RIGHT. Frontal wide composition on a broad icefield stone road; vivid aurora remains in the upper background and the chariot roof/silhouette stays below it. Reins and harnesses clearly link the driver's two hands to both horses and vehicle. Ice-cyan, deep violet, silver palette, natural skin and believable horse colors. Keep both horse heads apart, all legs and hooves clearly outlined, wheels visible. The full icy stone road and wheel contact ground must continue solidly into bottom bleed. Rich high-end hand-painted tarot art, thin engraved celestial gold border, crisp cold atmosphere. One driver, two horses, one chariot only; no snow or mist hiding legs, no floating pieces, no typography, title, letters, numbers, watermark or logo. Opaque full-canvas master.
generationRuns.conclusion: Selected opaque master after first-pass visual check; no transparent layers or assembly.

generationRuns.prompt: Edit the supplied image. Output exactly one 1024x1536 image. Keep the original canvas coordinates and size of RETAINED objects only. Objects explicitly removed must be deleted completely; do not preserve their number. No redesign, no recentering, no frame except when frame is specifically requested. BACKGROUND PLATE ONLY. Delete ALL people, ALL animals, ALL main foreground props, ALL foreground support platforms/floors and their contact shadows, ALL floating foreground decoration, and the entire outer border/corner ornaments. NO people or animals may remain, including silhouettes and reflections. Reconstruct the distant environment naturally behind deleted objects. Keep only the distant landscape/architecture and original atmosphere. Do not add a second copy of the support ground. Opaque RGB image. Specific removed connected group: 驾车者、双马、车、缰绳整体；只动周围水滴沙尘；本主题支撑归属：冰原石道与完整轮下地面. Environment ownership details: 除主体完整连接组、独立前景和固定框外的环境；必须补全清除区域，不保留重复主体或接触阴影。. Highest priority: an EMPTY clean environment, absolutely no protagonists or foreground props. Remove ALL decorative symbols attached to the margins, including the upper and lower crescents, attached stars, corner ornaments and rectangular border strokes. Fill those pixels with continuous natural environment textures. The result is a full-bleed clean background with absolutely NO card furniture. Image 1 is the edit target; opaque background plate.
generationRuns.conclusion: Generated candidate; user requested collective visual acceptance later.
